description: The trails starts just past Trout Creek recreation site at an approx. elevation of +/- 1062m. The trail winds its way through a forested area. To the northwest from the start of the trails is Castle Mountain with an elevation of 1437 m / 4714 ft . to the southeast is Bowen Mountain with an elevation of 1608 m / 5275 ft .
directions: From Christina Lake on Hwy 3 , turn off heading eastward onto Santa Rosa Road for +/- 13.9 km will get you to the trail head.
title: Upper Dewdney
